postCreateCommand: git config --global push.default current && sudo apt update && sudo apt install texlive-full -y && sudo apt install luatex -y && sudo apt install entr
postStartCommand: ls /workspaces/cv/cv.pdf | entr -r gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dCompatibilityLevel=1.4 -dPDFSETTINGS=/prepress -dNOPAUSE -dQUIET -dBATCH -sOutputFile=Kinuthia_CV.pdf cv.pdf & ls /workspaces/cv/coverletter.pdf | entr -r gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dCompatibilityLevel=1.4 -dPDFSETTINGS=/prepress -dNOPAUSE -dQUIET -dBATCH -sOutputFile=Kinuthia_CoverLetter.pdf coverletter.pdf & wait
